# telnyx_ai_memory_namespaces (Data Source)

Lists ai memory namespaces, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_ai_memory_namespace`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `ai_memory_namespaces` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_memory_namespaces))

<a id="nestedatt--ai_memory_namespaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_memory_namespaces`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The namespace's unique identifier.
- `name` (String) The namespace's name, used in the path. `default` exists for every organization.
